failures: Rounded endpoint serialization failed byte-exact node equality despite sub-micrometre numeric agreement.
A 20m port-tangent blend created isolated curvature spikes at the east and south port approaches.
The preregistered 2m nonincident-edge minimum was impossible for the frozen control itself, whose measured value is 1.617345854886502m.
Intersecting metric keys across short and long edges accidentally omitted the registered 16m statistics from the aggregate.

measured_post_failure_audit.interpretation: An absolute maximum-turn gate of 45 degrees rejects at least ten percent of real measured development edges. A distributional p90 gate plus a generous isolated-spike bound is the evidence-supported rule.

frozen_v2_corrections.endpoint_serialization: Restore exact original node arrays after rounding interior samples.
frozen_v2_corrections.metric_aggregation: Aggregate every metric over the subset of eligible edges that defines it; short edges no longer erase 16m metrics.

phase_search.selection: Choose the lowest objective score among hard-gate-pass attempts, breaking ties by the lowest attempt index.
phase_search.objective: Equal-weight normalized absolute distance to source-balanced measured medians for tortuosity, grade, and 4m/8m/16m turns.

corrected_hard_gates.minimum_nonincident_interpretation: No meaningful regression from the frozen control's 1.617m near-approach; this is not a general collision-clearance guarantee.

unchanged.candidate_arms: restrained, natural, wild with the v1 amplitude multipliers
unchanged.measured_corpus: 12 development cave sources, 15 segments, no validation or sealed geometry

claim_limit: Recovery of rejected offline trajectory candidates only; no Minecraft run, production deployment, trained population model, speleogenesis claim, or gate relaxation hidden from the record.
